unmatched.what: New trial registered: NCT07912164, by the Polish company Human Biome, a placebo-controlled test in 68 adults aged 45 to 80 of gut-bacteria transplant capsules, with the pace of ageing on the DunedinPACE clock as a main question; not yet recruiting, start planned for 2026-12.
unmatched.why_it_matters: A trial that uses a clock of ageing, not a disease, as its main yardstick; it bears on the measuring branch.

unmatched.what: Registry update for NCT04264897, the completed trial of whether metformin slows ageing in people without diabetes; results (posted 2026-07-02) show no significant difference on either main measure.
unmatched.why_it_matters: A negative result for the best-known candidate drug on the energy and fuel branch; also reported under the Barzilai claim.

unmatched.what: Design paper for AMICO, a three-year trial of metformin in 212 people with COPD, described by its authors as targeting accelerated ageing.
unmatched.why_it_matters: Metformin is being tested against ageing through single diseases while the general trial waits for money.

unmatched.what: Registry update for NCT07475546, AgelessRx's completed 26-person, 90-day pilot of combinations including rapamycin and metformin; no results posted.
unmatched.why_it_matters: A small combination trial aimed at healthspan; results would be the first of their kind from this company.

unmatched.what: Fight Aging! post on a study using circular RNA to deliver the Yamanaka factors so that reprogramming stays partial; read as the blog's account, the paper itself was not opened. The same blog reported on 2026-10-19, before the window, that Life Biosciences had given first results from the first human trial of partial reprogramming.
unmatched.why_it_matters: Laboratory progress on the safety problem of the cell-settings branch, on which Altos is the largest bet.
